description: Schema for top-down knowledge extraction of LLM security events from documents (papers, standards, incident reports). Organized by the 5W1H framework: Who (actors), When (lifecycle/time), Where (system locations), What (attacks/vulnerabilities/assets), WhyHow (mechanisms/defenses), Result (impacts). Derived from LLM_Security_KG_Schema_Table1.docx and refined for machine-guided extraction.

alignment_references.atlas: MITRE ATLAS (Adversarial Threat Landscape for AI Systems)

provenance_attributes.description: Attached to every extracted entity and relation instance, not declared per type.

attributes.name: sourceDoc
attributes.description: Source document identifier (file name without extension)

attributes.name: sourceCategory
attributes.description: Corpus category: arxiv | ICML | OWASP | cnki | other

attributes.name: mentionText

entity_types.name: Attacker

entity_types.name: AIAgent

entity_types.name: TrainingDataset

entity_types.name: ToolExecutionEnvironment

entity_types.name: APIEndpoint

entity_types.name: AgentMemory

attributes.name: atlasRef

entity_types.name: AttackEvent

attributes.name: attackId

attributes.name: variant

attributes.name: vector

attributes.name: eventTimestamp

entity_types.description: A weakness in an LLM system component that can be exploited

entity_types.name: Asset

entity_types.name: SecurityIncident

entity_types.name: KillChain

attributes.name: ttpSequence

entity_types.name: AttackStep

attributes.name: action
attributes.description: What the attacker does in this step

entity_types.name: TriggerCondition

entity_types.name: DefenseMechanism
entity_types.description: A defense, mitigation, or governance mechanism. Instances must use one of the enumerated defense types.

attributes.name: method

attributes.name: effectiveness

entity_types.name: SecurityImpact
entity_types.description: The consequence of an attack. Instances must use one of the enumerated impact types.

attributes.name: quantifiedLoss

entity_rules: Every extracted entity must have exactly one entity type from this schema.
AttackTechnique.techniqueName, DefenseMechanism.defenseType, and SecurityImpact.impactType must use the enumerated values; map synonyms to the closest enum value.
Distinguish AttackTechnique (the abstract class, e.g. 'prompt injection') from AttackEvent (a concrete instance described in the text); the two are linked via usesTechnique.
Do not invent entities not supported by the text; every entity needs a mentionText span.
relation_rules: Only use relation names defined in this schema; subject and object types must satisfy the domain/range constraints.
occursIn/during are TEMPORAL anchors; injectedInto is the SPATIAL anchor. Never use them interchangeably.
Self-loops (subject == object) are invalid and must be discarded.
Each triplet needs a mentionText span supporting it.
